subject: Geopolitics
title: Nuclear Energy Renaissance
description: A short lesson to help you apply Nuclear Energy Renaissance.

hook.text: After decades of fear, nuclear power is back. Climate change made the risk of not using it scarier than reactor risk.

buildup.text: Nuclear provides 10% of global electricity with near-zero carbon emissions. It runs 24/7 regardless of weather.

discovery.text: Small modular reactors promise cheaper, faster builds.

twist.text: Nuclear carries proliferation risk. Every civilian reactor produces knowledge and material relevant to weapons.

climax.text: The nuclear renaissance balances climate urgency against proliferation risk.

punchline.text: Split the atom for clean power. Pray it stays peaceful.

quiz.question: Why is nuclear energy experiencing a renaissance?
options: New reactors are immune to all safety risks
Climate change made carbon-free baseload power more urgent
Nuclear fuel costs dropped to near zero
